prosperous.description: Confirmed demand and delivery activity: customer queue, arriving stock and a van. Static figures are not walking animation.

quiet.description: Reduced confirmed footfall: no customer queue or delivery activity. Quiet premises alone do not imply insolvency.

low-stock.description: Reported low inventory: an empty stock rack and low-stock indicator. The base building is unchanged.

maintenance.description: A reported maintenance issue adds a small repair prop and warning. This is not inferred from a city-wide recession.

closed.description: Temporary closure: no activity, explicit closure badge and dynamic notice. Reopening follows the server status.

bankrupt.description: Confirmed bankruptcy: boarded panel, empty rack, no customers and an explicit notice. Abandonment is a separate presentation policy.

acquired.description: Only a confirmed ownership-transfer event changes the owner label. The physical business remains the same.

expanding.description: Confirmed upgrade job: construction worker and existing crane. A proposal or available upgrade is not construction.

celebrating.description: Confirmed success milestone: small customer gathering and a success badge. No invented profit multiplier or permanent confetti.
